notes.title: Frameblade Manifesto
notes.content:
From this day on, our games belong to the players.

The Frameblade team works primarily to bring their ideas to life and give players a new and interesting experience, so now you can play all of our existing and future projects absolutely free.

For those who would like to support our team, we have added a paid DLC called "Supporter Pack" to each game. No, it does not give its owner any advantages, but simply adds a thank you message to the game.

Everyone who bought/received our games before today will receive Supporter Packs for the corresponding games automatically.

notes.title: Hotfix - 08.29.2021
notes.content:
• Fixed a bug where at the "The Hunt" level in some cases the enemies stopped spawning after skipping dialogs

• Fixed a bug where the turret tower did not turn red when getting damage

• Added a new animation of the death of the final boss

• Fixed typos in some dialogs

notes.title: Update - 08.25.2021
notes.content:
• Developed and implemented a new concept of the Wall - boss from the "Assault" level. Added various new behaviors using the Bullethell mechanic

[img]https://psv4.userapi.com/c856432/u277514009/docs/d9/d8f8e2b361b8/Project_1_1.gif[/img]

• Changed the behavior of the Turret. Now the Turret tower does not rotate randomly, but gradually rotates from top to bottom.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40885502/ab477abc33a4d1e23f0d9962f81d200d433dfe22.gif[/img]

• The reload time of the Heavy Fighter's guns has been increased.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40885502/d016e4ad9c2f0e9340d08d549c48166e09fd1c9b.gif[/img]

• Added the ability to skip in-game dialogues. A skip prompt appears in the upper right corner of the screen.

• Added the ability to use the bonus by clicking on RMB.

• Other minor fixes and improvements
